description: This Java class configures a batch job in the Spring Batch framework for purging processed commands. It defines beans for the job and its step, wiring in dependencies like JobRepository, transaction manager, and a tasklet to perform the purge.

classes.name: PurgeProcessedCommandsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class setting up a Spring Batch job for purging processed commands using a tasklet.

methods.name: purgeProcessedCommandsStep
methods.description: Defines the batch job step that executes the purge tasklet.

methods.name: purgeProcessedCommandsJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job for purging processed commands, starting with the step above.
